**Unofficial, experimental, vibe-coded Windows port of the [Ladybird](https://ladybird.org) browser.** Not made by or
endorsed by the Ladybird project. It builds and starts, but it needs fixes, and most of it is untested.

- **`Ladybird-Setup.exe`**: installer. Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box because it is not
  code-signed: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **`Ladybird-windows-x64.zip`**: no install. Unzip it, open the `bin` folder and run `Ladybird.exe`. Keep the folder
  together.

64-bit Windows only. Please report problems as issues on this repository, not upstream. Licenses: see `LICENSE` and
`NOTICE.txt` in the download.
